# KTouch course source snapshot

- Upstream: <https://invent.kde.org/education/ktouch>
- Revision: `a3f57d03e6c14956378af1176eef3404430c773e`
- Imported course: `data/courses/gb.xml`
- Course SHA-256: `54441dfcc0be7fe11bde1e9b6f74f7b3bc7c6134acbeae5369ef8e0a632df20f`
- Included repository license: `LICENSES/GPL-2.0-or-later.txt`
- License SHA-256: `b58671fb4d9e9efeb9a6af1bdba02e61ac69af654855b45a372efe8f52413f83`

The upstream course identifies itself as auto-generated by a Perl script by
Steinar Theigmann and Håvard Frøiland. The XML file has no file-level SPDX
identifier. The repository includes GPL-2.0-or-later among its license texts;
this snapshot preserves both the attribution and the unresolved file-level
mapping instead of claiming stronger provenance than the source provides.

The original XML is immutable. `scripts/build-learning-course.mjs` creates the
runtime JSON and records the one approved minimum repair: the final
capitalisation lesson declares A–Z but omits Q, X, and Y, so those three
characters are appended to that lesson's conversion output.
